about_the_game:
MODULAR

Connect. Upgrade. Survive. Evolve.

Welcome to MODULAR, a 2D sci-fi adventure where you begin with a single core module and forge your own path through a danger. Find and connect new modules to expand your capabilities—whether it's weapons, shields, engines, or research labs. Your "MODULAR" is what you make it.

Explore strange worlds, uncover new technologies, and adapt to survive against hostile environments. Each decision shapes your journey. Will you focus on exploration, engineering, or combat? The power is in your hands — literally.

Features:

  • Modular Gameplay – Attach and combine different ship modules to build your own playstyle.

  • Open-Ended Progression – No two runs are the same. Unlock new tech, abilities, and upgrades as you go. (we are always adding more)

  • Rich Sci-Fi World – Mysterious environments, modules, and strange phenomena await discovery.

  • Challenging Combat – Strategic battles with reactive enemies that adapt to your build. (super scary)

  • Atmospheric Visuals & Sound – A minimalist yet immersive aesthetic paired with a dynamic soundtrack.

MODULAR is about freedom, creativity, and survival in a universe that doesn’t wait for anyone.
